name: Truck World: Australia - First Haul
description:
Truck World: Australia – First Haul is your first mission as a truck driver in the red heart of Australia. Hit the road through the continent’s vast deserts – miles of road, scorching heat and a face-to-face encounter with a real sandstorm await.

Conquer the Sandstorm

Battle a roaring wall of dust that rocks your rig and cuts sight to almost nothing – just a glimpse of the dynamic weather system that brings storms, fog, rain and more to every journey.

Freedom Beyond the Cab

Step out of your truck to manually secure the load, lower and raise the trailer legs, and connect or disconnect the hitch. Take full control over every stage of your delivery.

Outback Adventure

Explore Australia’s stunning red wilderness. Swap smooth highways for rugged dirt tracks and muddy backroads that can trap your wheels. Deliver vital cargo and help solve real-world challenges – not just for yourself but for the entire Outback community.

Next-Gen Physics and Visuals

Feel every bump, every turn and every blast of wind. Witness breathtaking sunrises and sunsets behind the wheel of a multi-tonne truck, fully immersed in a new generation of trucking realism.

First Haul Is Just the Beginning

We’re actively developing and expanding the game – and your feedback plays a vital role. Share your thoughts – we’re listening and building a better journey together!
